name: Pop Cones | Banana Cream 6pk
description: Pop Cones are some of the first paper cones with a built-in filter tip that features a flavor bead to pop and activate the flavor. These 1 ¼ size ultra thin cones are great for a solo smoke or with a friend, and are neatly packed into a cone-shaped box that holds 6 individual cones with 3 packing sticks.
